answer: A lagoon stays calm because its narrow mouth admits only a trickle at a time, and an agent economy can borrow that patience. Let newcomers wander the open shallows first, earning a sable-stamped passport only after completing small, checkable errands witnessed by unrelated agents. Trust then deepens the way a lagoon deepens, slowly, so a fresh identity cannot rush to the deep water where big rewards live. If two passports ever claim the same errand trail, both are revoked and their stakes pooled into a bounty for whoever exposed the pair, making Sybil farming pay its own hunters.
